videos.title: Chuck and the First Peoples' Kitchen
videos.description: Chuck visits Winnipeg, Manitoba, home to the largest urban Indigenous population in Canada, and learns all about Métis cuisine; he meets with passionate Indigenous residents who help make the city a better place with the help of a community oven.

videos.title: Wall of Chefs
videos.description: The home cooks go global with crowd-pleasers from around the world, and kelp has everyone reeling when they take a deep dive into Chef Todd Perrin's fridge; Chef Christine Cushing asks the final two cooks to make a dish inspired by their childhoods.

videos.title: Jamie's Quick & Easy Food
videos.description: Sticky kickin' chicken wings; sirloin with aubergines; creamy garlic mushroom pasta; rum 'n' raisin ice cream.

videos.title: Cook Like an Italian
videos.description: Silvia returns to the kitchen to take you through 3 dishes from the famous region of Emilia-Romagna in Italy, known not only for its stunning landscape but also for the beauty and richness and of its food.

videos.title: Wall of Bakers
videos.description: The home bakers take inspiration from family favorites to create their crowd-pleasers; Chef Andrew Han presents the bakers with bananas and black sesame paste in his pantry; Chef Anna Olson asks the final two home bakers to re-invent a classic.

videos.title: Top Down Challenge
videos.description: Chef Jasmine competes against her student Chef Bella to see who can re-create the best stuffed pizza doughnut.

videos.title: Top Down Challenge
videos.description: Top-down challenge judges Chase and Olivia flip the script and compete against each other.

videos.title: Flat Out Food
videos.description: Examine how traditional foods that can be foraged or hunted have provided nourishment for the people on this land for thousands of years; Jenn learns about some of these ingredients and their uses.

videos.title: Flat Out Food
videos.description: Saskatchewan produces the second most amount of honey in Canada; Jenn learns about bees; explore how honey can be used to elevate a dish.

videos.title: UpRooted With Sarah Sharratt
videos.description: Sarah pulls off a traditional Thanksgiving dinner with the help of her local butcher and family members visiting from the US; Sarah collects fresh vegetables to make Ratatouille to go along with butternut squash soup, stuffed turkey and pumpkin pie.

videos.title: UpRooted With Sarah Sharratt
videos.description: Sarah is invited by her local mayor to accompany him on a seasonal pigeon hunt; Sarah throws a dinner party featuring pigeon stuffed with sausage and fennel seeds and Pommes Dauphinoise; a dessert of apple and Armagnac Tresse is served.

videos.title: Jamie's 15 Minute Meals
videos.description: Jamie makes crispy Camembert parcels, autumn salad and cranberry dip, plus a golden chicken with braised greens and potato gratin.

videos.title: Jamie's 15 Minute Meals
videos.description: Jamie creates a beef stroganoff, with fluffy rice and red onion and parsley pickle; Moroccan mussels with tapenade toasties and cucumber salad.

videos.title: Jamie's Quick & Easy Food
videos.description: Cooking up a tender lamb shoulder; super green spaghetti, a speedy veggie pasta; one-pan fish; rice; apple crumble cookies.

videos.description: A diverse group of chefs create mouth-watering plant-based dumplings, fried `chik'n' sandwiches and Vietnamese `catfish`; Mena forages for lobster mushrooms and visits the oldest tofu factory in America.

videos.description: Raymond Blanc rustles up simple, delicious dishes in his Oxfordshire kitchen.

videos.description: Anna prepares a variety of fruit mousses and also demonstrates how they can be enjoyed on its own or as part of a grand dessert.

videos.description: To secure the final spot in the championship, bakers first must get through the elimination round using candy canes in their cupcakes; the final two bakers compete in a toy shop-themed cupcake showdown for $10,000.

videos.description: The best holiday bakers compete in the Holiday Championship Finale, facing eggnog in the elimination round; the final two bakers compete for a total of $20,000 and the title of Holiday Champion in a Night Before Christmas-themed cake showdown.
